node.statement: Let U_- be the union of the coordinate fibers in T_-. Since d_Q = sum_{j in Q}(q_j-P_vj) = q(Q)-c_Q is negative on T_-, one has sum_{Q in T_-}|d_Q| = c(U_-)-q(U_-). Now c(U_-) <= sum_{Q in T_-}max(c_Q,0) <= K_C*delta by the tail cap, while q(U_-) >= -nu(q) >= -delta. Hence sum_{Q in T_-}|d_Q| <= (K_C+1)*delta.
